whatThisIs: THE SIGN-IN LIST RULE, DECLARED ONCE FOR BOTH PORTALS (convergence decision 2, 2026-10-18).
An entry on the sign-in list sets the role of an account only when the account is created.
It never raises or lowers an existing account at sign-in, and approving an entry never changes
an existing account either. A later change of role is an explicit administrator action on
Manage users, and it writes an audit entry. This file is byte-identical in the two repositories,
and so are backend/app/services/signin_role.py and its test.

copy.newAccountsOnly: New accounts only. To change an existing account, use Manage users.
copy.roleKept: {email} already has an account, as {current}. Its role stays; change it on Manage users.
